page_annotations: Apart from the folio number and three overflow notes keyed to fol. 294, the page is ruled and otherwise blank after image review.
There are faint dashed or dotted strokes and a hook mark at mid-page (about y2340–2500). They contain no legible text and are probably stray marks or show-through.
The bottom region and margins were reviewed and contain no text.
The region right of the gutter (x > about 3100) belongs to fol. 294 and is not transcribed as target records.
unresolved_relationships: The attachment of each note to its fol. 294 entry rests on arrow position and row alignment, so it is probable rather than secure.

coverage.finding: The ink folio number '293ᵇ.' at the top left is correctly transcribed.

The single overflow line is present. The reading 'ff. 1 and 2' remains uncertain. The written form of the name looks like 'Nilakaṇṭha': the i has a dot, and no macron is clearly visible. The candidate's literal 'Nīlakaṇṭha' asserts a macron that the image does not secure. The left arrow at the gutter (about x3025,y1520) pairs with the right arrow before c. 386(8) on fol. 294.

The line is present and the readings agree in substance. However, the source writes '(sic)' closed up against the neighbouring words in the first instance ('Ummaṇa(sic)Bhatta'), whereas the candidate inserts spaces. Both instances of 'sic' are underlined. The first 'Bhatta' shows no clear underdots; the second 'Bhaṭṭa' has them. The gutter arrow with a cross-stroke at about y1660 aligns with d. 111(2).
'ff. 1-6, Saṁv. 1817' is correctly transcribed. The left arrow at about x2905,y2590 aligns with the dash before c. 43(2) on fol. 294, whose date reads 1817:6:9:D.
